environment.description: Same EKS cluster but pod egress is routed through an Istio sidecar (envoy proxy) configured with a custom EnvoyFilter resource. The EnvoyFilter applies an ext_authz filter on all outbound connections from the pod's network namespace. The ext_authz service validates that the destination presents a valid mTLS certificate signed by the internal CA (cert-manager issuer 'webhook-destinations-ca') before the TCP connection is established. Destinations that cannot complete the mTLS handshake with a cert chaining to this specific CA have their connections RST'd at the proxy level. The IMDS endpoint (169.254.169.254) and all link-local addresses are additionally blocked by a Cilium L3 NetworkPolicy applied to the pod label selector, but the primary control is the mTLS requirement on all egress HTTP(S) which means even if DNS rebinding resolves to an internal IP, the target must present a valid client-cert-verified TLS certificate from the internal PKI to receive any payload.

config.envoy_filter: ext_authz on outbound, requires peer cert from 'webhook-destinations-ca' issuer
config.network_policy: Cilium L3 deny to 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 metadata ranges
config.istio_peer_auth: STRICT mTLS for all outbound from namespace
config.imds: IMDSv1 on nodes but blocked at pod network level
